[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. Light rays sway gently through the deep teal water and tiny bubbles drift upward along the lily stems. The camera rises slowly at a steady speed in one continuous move, drifting up between the stems toward the glowing surface until it reaches the waterline, the frame splitting into the calm underwater world below and the lily pads and white flowers glowing in the sunrise above. The camera is still rising as the shot ends on <Picture 2>. No cut or transition occurs.
